description: Use when you need a block header on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon or Optimism: latest or a given number, with hash, parent, timestamp, miner, gas used/limit. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /evm/block, $0.001 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge.
